picks.reason: A gay Mormon's struggle with faith and identity offers profound insight.

picks.title: You Are Invited - Religion to Redemption - Matthew S6E3
picks.summary:
What happens when religion gets in the way of redemption?
 In Matthew 21:23–22:14, Jesus confronts the religious leaders through three powerful parables that expose the difference between simply looking religious and truly surrendering to Him. We see that salvation cannot be earned through good works or religious activity. 
The invitation to the Kingdom is extended to everyone, but we must respond with repentance, faith, and surrender to Jesus.

It can become the wisdom, compassion, and strength you use to help someone else. Joe tackles the difficult subject of sexual abuse and generational trauma, sharing his own experiences and exploring how unresolved wounds can continue affecting relationships, self-worth, intimacy, and the next gene

picks.title: South Beach Sessions - Lamar Odom
picks.summary:
“It's all about the comeback.”



Lamar Odom has lived through extraordinary highs and devastating lows - and he speaks about all of it with remarkable honesty. In this deeply personal conversation, Lamar reflects with Dan Le Batard on losing his mother at 12, finding purpose through basketball, addiction, grief, faith, and surviving 12 strokes and six heart attacks. Lamar relives waking up three days after entering a bar, unable to walk or talk, and being told he might never do either again. Now, Lamar shares with Dan that he sees his story as a responsibility: to use what he survived to help
picks.reason: Lamar Odom reflects honestly on faith, suffering, and survival after severe trauma.

picks.title: Should Christians PRAY to Saints!? (Pastors REACT To Viral Video) | Live Free with Josh Howerton
picks.summary:
In Episode 90 of the LIVE FREE Podcast, Pastors Josh Howerton, Carlos Erazo, and Paul Cunningham uncover surprising lessons hidden inside some of the Bible passages we usually skim—including the stories of Mark, Demas, Rufus, and Quartus. Their lives reveal powerful truths about failure, restoration, friendship, legacy, and lifelong faithfulness.

The conversation also gets intensely practical: Who are the people carrying your mat when you're struggling? Is it biblical to pray for God's judgment on someone? And why does Scripture teach that Christians can approach God directly through Jesus?
picks.reason: Explores biblical stories with practical faith lessons, lightly on ultimate questions.

picks.title: Episode 386: Raised in the Woods, Survived a Serial Killer & Finding Hope | feat. Kelsey Vandermyde
picks.summary: This week we sit down with Kelsey, who grew up deep in the mountains of Montana with no electricity, no running water, and a father convinced the world was ending. From polygamy and mountain lions to a serial killer staying in their cabin, Kelsey's story is one of the wildest you'll ever hear. JP and the crew don't see eye to eye with Kelsey on everything when it comes to faith — but that's exactly what makes this conversation worth having. Come for the crazy story, stay for the honest and gracious dialogue!
picks.reason: A survival story with some faith discussion but mostly personal narrative.

picks.showTitle: The Bible in a Year (with Fr. Mike Schmitz)
picks.title: Day 239: Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah (2026)
picks.summary:
Fr. Mike shares one of his favorite Bible verses, and guides us through the story of Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah as they are thrown into the fiery furnace. He also emphasizes the significance of their Hebrew names, and how powerful name changes are in Scripture. Today's readings are Jeremiah 22, Daniel 3, and Proverbs 15:29-33.

For the complete reading plan, visit ascensionpress.com/bibleinayear.

Please note: The Bible contains adult themes that may not be suitable for children - parental discretion is advised.]]>
picks.reason: A Bible story emphasizing faith and identity through name changes, with some spiritual reflection.
